blocked_locations.description: Closed roads 0044, 0076, and 0089 at junction loc_0028, a low‑degree node bridging the southern cluster to the main corridor. Their removal forces traffic to detour via longer routes through loc_0022 and loc_0021, increasing travel time.

Robbery blocking roads 0106 and 0105 at junction loc_0065, which is a key link between the northern and central sections. The incident removes a short, low‑distance path (0106) and an alternative corridor (0105), compelling drivers to use the longer 0032 route.
